name: SocialChoice.Voting.modifiedForwardProfile_spec
lines: hC : ∀ i ∈ C, Prefers P i x z
(Prefers P i x z ↔ Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i x z) ∧
(Prefers P i z x ↔ Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i z x) ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i x y ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i y z) ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i y x ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i y z)
⊢ (Prefers P i x z ↔ Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i x z) ∧
(Prefers P i z x ↔ Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i z x) ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i x y ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i y z) ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i y x ∧
Prefers (modifiedForwardProfile P C x y z hxy hxz hyz) i y z)
⊢ (BallotPrefers (P.pref i) x z ↔ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x z) ∧
(BallotPrefers (P.pref i) z x ↔ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x) ∧
BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x y ∧
BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) y z
⊢ BallotPrefers (P.pref i) x z ↔ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x z
⊢ (BallotPrefers (P.pref i) z x ↔ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x) ∧
BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x y ∧ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) y z
⊢ BallotPrefers (P.pref i) x z → BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x z
⊢ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x z → BallotPrefers (P.pref i) x z
⊢ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x z
a✝ : BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x z
⊢ BallotPrefers (P.pref i) z x ↔ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x
⊢ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) x y ∧ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) y z
⊢ BallotPrefers (P.pref i) z x → BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x
⊢ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x → BallotPrefers (P.pref i) z x
⊢ BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x
hzxi : BallotPrefers (betweenBallot (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz) z x

steps.tactic:
classical
intro i
by_cases hi : i ∈ C
· simp [modifiedForwardProfile, hi, Prefers]
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro _
      exact betweenBallot_xz (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz
    · intro _
      exact hC i hi
  constructor
  · construct …
exact betweenBallot_xz (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz
exact False.elim ((Prefers.asymm P i (hC i hi)) hzxi)
exact False.elim ((BallotPrefers.asymm _ (betweenBallot_xz (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz)) hzxi)
exact ⟨betweenBallot_xy (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz, betweenBallot_yz (P.pref i) hxy hxz hyz⟩
have hz_ne_y : z ≠ y := Ne.symm hyz
simp [modifiedForwardProfile, hi, Prefers, topBallot_preserves, hx_ne_y, hz_ne_y, topBallot_top]
